title: Motorized 3-Roll Plate Rollers & Plate Rolls | NovoTech
meta_description: Mechanical 3-roll plate rolling machines from 3.4 to 10 ft, up to 3/8″ plate, cone bending and composite-panel rolls. CSA panels, parts in Mississauga, ON.
intro: Mechanical plate rolling machines for aluminum, HVAC ducting, signage panels, machine guards and sheet-metal enclosures: a planetary gearbox or gear train drives the rolls, the back roll is adjusted by motor or hand wheel and a manual drop-end releases the cylinder. The MRM-S rolls up to 3/8″ plate on working lengths to 10 ft and has a composite-panel version with a Delrin-coated top roll; the IRM and RM are the value-priced motorized plate rollers small workshops ask for. All with CSA-approved panels, parts and support from Mississauga, ON.

groups.title: Motorized 3-roll plate rollers
groups.lead: MRM-S, IRM and RM: mechanical initial-pinch plate rolls from 3.4 ft to 10 ft.

faq.q: MRM-S, IRM or RM — what is the difference?
faq.a: Roll diameter and construction. The MRM-S has 130–220 mm rolls on a welded frame with planetary drive and motorized back roll and takes plate to 3/8″; the IRM has 110–140 mm rolls on cast-iron frames for sheet to 3/16″; the RM has 90–95 mm rolls on a reinforced steel frame for sheet to 11 ga. Choose by the thickest sheet and the smallest diameter you roll.

faq.q: Can I roll aluminum composite panels (Alucobond) without marking them?
faq.a: Yes — the MRM-S composite-panel version has a top roll covered in segmented hard-plastic (Delrin) rings so the painted panel is not marked. It is used for curved signage, architectural cladding and outdoor design work.

faq.q: Do motorized plate rollers bend cones?
faq.a: Every MRM-S, IRM and RM has a cone-bending device: one end of the top roll is lowered so the sheet travels faster on the wide end. The optional digital readout on the back roll makes repeat cones easier.

faq.q: What voltage do İşitan plate rollers run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor. Manual slip rolls have no electrics.
